_readme: What's Good Local weekly deals feed for Maui. Written by the weekly scheduled task; see CLAUDE.md.

deals.name: Coconut's Fish Cafe
deals.deal: $8 happy hour dishes, daily 2:30-4:30 PM and 7:30-8:30 PM
deals.details: Happy hour dishes at $8 include Paniolo beef sliders, Caesar salad, calamari, onion rings, coconut shrimp and volcano chicken bites.

deals.name: Merriman's Kapalua
deals.deal: Happy hour small plates from $8; $3 off well drinks, $4 off house wine
deals.details: Happy hour at The Point 3 to 5 PM (weather permitting) and the main bar 4 to 5 PM, not on select holidays. Small plates include truffle fries $8, taro hummus $10 and kalua pork quesadilla $15.

deals.name: Monkeypod Kitchen Wailea
deals.deal: Happy hour daily 2:30-5 PM: half-price appetizers, $16 pizzas
deals.details: Daily happy hour except select holidays; appetizers half off (seafood excluded), pizzas $16 (except the Bourgeois), with $2 off drafts, $3 off wine and $4 off cocktails.

deals.name: Sansei Kapalua
deals.deal: Early bird: 50% off food and sushi, Sun & Mon 5-5:45 PM
deals.details: Dine-in only, first come, first served with no reservations; certain items are not discounted.

deals.name: Tommy Bahama Wailea
deals.deal: Happy hour daily 3-5 PM
deals.details: The restaurant lists happy hour from 3 to 5 PM daily.

deals.name: Café O'Lei Kihei
deals.deal: Happy hour menu, 3:30-5 PM
deals.details: The restaurant lists a happy hour menu from 3:30 to 5 PM.

deals.name: Coconut's Fish Cafe (Kamaole)
deals.deal: $4 Aloha Pours: craft draft or house red, white or rosé
deals.details: $4 pours during happy hour, daily 2:30 to 4:30 PM and 7:30 to 8:30 PM, at the Kamaole location only.

deals.name: Hula Grill Kāʻanapali
deals.deal: Aloha Hour: $13 select cocktails, $7 16 oz drafts, 2-4 PM
deals.details: Aloha Hour menu from 2 to 4 PM with select cocktails at $13 and 16 oz drafts at $7, plus small bites.

deals.name: Manoli's Pizza Company
deals.deal: Happy hour noon-5 PM daily: $3 off cocktails and beer, $8 house wine
deals.details: Happy hour every day from noon to 5 PM with $3 off the cocktail and beer menu, $8 house wine and food specials.

deals.name: Milagros Food Company
deals.deal: Happy hour 3-6 PM
deals.details: The restaurant lists happy hour from 3 to 6; it is open 11 AM to 9 PM.

deals.name: Monkeypod Kitchen Kāʻanapali
deals.deal: Happy hour daily 2:30-5 PM: $4 off cocktails, $3 off wine, $2 off drafts
deals.details: Daily happy hour except select holidays, also with half-price appetizers (seafood excluded) and $16 pizzas.

deals.name: Sea House Restaurant
deals.deal: Happy hour 2-4:45 PM
deals.details: Happy hour at the Sea House at Napili Kai Beach Resort runs from 2 to 4:45 PM.

deals.name: South Shore Tiki Lounge
deals.deal: Happy hour 11 AM-6 PM
deals.details: The bar lists happy hour from 11 AM to 6 PM.
deals.location: Kīhei · Kihei Kalama Village, 1913-J S Kihei Rd

deals.name: Taverna
deals.deal: Happy hour daily 2:30-4:30 PM
deals.details: The Kapalua restaurant lists a daily happy hour from 2:30 to 4:30 PM.

deals.name: The Pour House
deals.deal: Happy hour daily 5-6 PM
deals.details: Happy hour every day from 5 to 6 PM.

deals.name: Blue Water Rafting
deals.deal: $10 off for military, first responders, teachers, locals and repeat guests
deals.details: The operator lists a $10 discount for military, first responders, teachers, locals, pilots, flight attendants and repeat guests. Its site also lists $10 off snorkel and whale watching tours with code ADVANCE10.

deals.name: Four Winds II
deals.deal: Book online: Molokini snorkel $180 adult (reg. $190), $135 child (reg. $145)
deals.details: Online prices for the 5-hour Molokini Crater snorkel tour, plus tax and fees; the 3.5-hour Coral Gardens tour is $120 adult (reg. $125) and $85 child (reg. $90). Departs Māʻalaea Harbor.

deals.name: Maui Ocean Center
deals.deal: Kamaʻāina admission: $29.95 adult, $19.95 child, $26.95 senior
deals.details: Reduced admission with a valid Hawaiʻi ID or military ID; standard admission is $49.95 adult, $39.95 child and $44.95 senior. Open daily 9 AM to 5 PM, last entry 4 PM.

deals.name: PacWhale Eco-Adventures
deals.deal: Buy one, get one free on the Māʻalaea classic whale watch through Dec 20
deals.details: The BOGO offer applies to adult and paying child fares (regular $99.05 adult, $55.55 child); children 4 and under ride free with a paying adult. Departs Māʻalaea Harbor.

deals.name: UFO Parasail
deals.deal: Early Bird: 15% off parasail flights
deals.details: Early Bird times are marked when booking: 1,200 ft flight $116 (reg. $136), 800 ft flight $99 (reg. $116), observer $65 (reg. $75). Departs Kāʻanapali Beach in front of Whalers Village.
deals.location: Kāʻanapali Beach · in front of Whalers Village
